$comment: Written at merge time from the pilot run. data/distill/llm-finglish.jsonl.br is GENERATED by training/tiny_finglish_training/build_distill.py --merge.

source.leakageGuard: load_gold_keys(*EVALUATION_FILES): gold, quarantined gold and dev sentences excluded before sampling

workers.claude: Claude Opus 5 in-session subagents, shards 0-17 (5,400 variants)
workers.luna: Codex CLI 0.154.0, gpt-5.6-luna, reasoning xhigh, herdr panes, shards 18-19 (600 variants)

fidelityTest.method: scripts/fidelity.ts: LLM typists romanized the dev set faithful Persian; compared with the human typing of the same sentences
fidelityTest.humanEngineAccuracy: 68.4% (rules engine on human typing vs faithful, 299 rows)

v1.verdict: failed: every persona exaggerated one habit (aa 38/100w vs human 18; u 7 vs 0.3; final eh 13 vs 1)

v2.engineOnLlmTyping: 80.3% / 85.8% vs 67.0% human on the same rows
v2.verdict: passed on habits; still easier to convert than human typing

modelRetrain.config: 102k architecture unchanged (d_model 64, d_hidden 96, 2 layers), int6; 110,018 params after the label vocabulary grew
modelRetrain.metric: dev strict / dev faithful / fixtures, model engine

uses.generatorFix: training/tiny_finglish_training/g2p.py wrote Persian letters (ع ئ ء ؤ) into the Latin side of 21,008 of 425,590 synthetic examples; fixed before any arm was trained

termsOfUse: Outputs of Claude (Anthropic) and GPT-5.6 luna (OpenAI) are used to fit a 1 KiB channel table and to train a 110k-parameter transliterator. Recorded so a reader can check this against the providers current terms; a character-level transliterator is not a general model competing with either.
